entities.summary: Ruan Ji (210–263), courtesy name Sizong, was a Chinese musician, poet, and military officer who lived in the late Eastern Han dynasty and Three Kingdoms period. He was one of the Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove. The guqin melody Jiukuang is believed to have been composed by him. At one time an infantry colonel, he was also known as Ruan Bubing.
